rationale: The candidate gives the key supported solution: register a callback with `OnInitialize` (`cobra.go:97-101`). It correctly establishes that flag parsing occurs first at `command.go:883-891`, followed by `c.preRun()` at `command.go:926`, whose loop invokes registered initializers at `command.go:1015-1019`. It also correctly cites `Command.Flag(name)` as looking up local flags and then persistent flags via `c.persistentFlag(name)` (`command.go:1794-1803`). Thus the proposed callback can access the parsed persistent flag value, while package initialization itself should only register that callback.
